automatedChecks.creationIncomingRecipeRegression: Five tests execute production selectCharacter, setBackdrop and applyRecipe with scene and DOM stubs, checking hidden original-mode rebuilds and saved backdrop restoration.

limitations: Asset authored by abstrakt; no claim of new reconstruction or training by this project.
Tint is overall RGB multiplication; local fur painting and trim are available only on the previous procedural models.
Whole-character transforms drive movement; no bones, independent fibers, deformable Gaussian training or clothing simulation.
Baked Gaussian appearance does not physically relight with the furniture lights.
Native Gaussian model PLY export and wardrobe adaptation are not implemented.
Full SH3 asset decoding and sorting require modern WebGL hardware; mobile and memory behavior remain unverified.
